context: Generate the procedural world for a strategy game with multi‑level zoom (local, regional, national). Use a deterministic seed to create a consistent world across all levels of detail.
description: Provides high‑level algorithms to produce height fields, biomes, rivers and vegetation density maps at macro (national) resolution, then refines them into regional and local tiles as needed.

classes.name: UWorldGenerator
classes.description: Core generator that takes a seed and outputs deterministic world data at different levels of detail.

methods.name: Init(seed)
methods.description: Initializes internal noise generators and state using a global seed.
methods.pseudocode: Set this.seed = seed; initialize noise and random generators with seed.

methods.name: GenHeightMacro()
methods.description: Generate a low‑resolution height map for the entire world.
methods.pseudocode: Use multi‑octave noise (e.g., OpenSimplex) to produce a 2D array of elevations; optionally apply tectonic masks.

methods.name: GenBiomes(heightField)
methods.description: Compute biome map based on temperature and humidity derived from height and latitude.
methods.pseudocode: For each cell: compute temperature = f(latitude, height); compute humidity = f(distance_to_ocean, prevailing_wind); look up biome from (temperature, humidity).

methods.name: GenRivers(heightField, rainMap)
methods.description: Calculate flow accumulation and derive river graph.
methods.pseudocode: Compute flow direction for each cell pointing to the steepest neighbor; accumulate flow from upstream; mark cells with flow greater than a threshold as river; connect into a river graph.

methods.name: GenTile(tileKey)
methods.description: Generate a specific regional or local tile by refining macro data.
methods.pseudocode: Sample the macro height map for the tile bounds; add higher‑frequency noise; optionally apply light erosion; compute local rivers and vegetation density; return TileData.

pseudocode: Init global seed and noise functions.
Generate macro height map and biome data once at startup.
For each camera zoom level request, generate or load regional/local tiles using GenTile.
